 Asta Achieves Devil Union, Magna and Zora Crash Dante’s Rampage in “Black Clover 2nd Season” Episode 5
 By Shuntaro Nishizawa, Animate Times 
 - Oct 30, 2026 - 08:00 
 All 
 The magic continues to surge! Black Clover 2nd Season is currently airing every Saturday, with online streaming available on Crunchyroll.
 Ahead of the October 31st broadcast, we’ve got an exclusive first look at the preview images and synopsis for Episode 5, titled “The Highest vs. the Lowest.” Stay tuned!
 <The following content is quoted from the official announcement>
 Episode 5: “The Highest vs. the Lowest”
 Synopsis 
 Just as Nacht finds himself in a desperate pinch, Asta storms onto the battlefield! Achieving “Devil Union” with Liebe, Asta prepares to stand his ground against the overwhelming chill of Lilith. Meanwhile, the battle rages elsewhere as Jack the Ripper faces off against Dante of the Dark Triad, who has now tapped into 100% of his devil powers.
 The situation looks dire for Jack until two familiar faces from the Black Bulls—Magna and Zora—arrive to back him up. Dante remains unfazed, flaunting his monstrous mana with an arrogant smirk. However, Magna has an ace up his sleeve: “Soul Chain Deathmatch,” a brand-new Secret Flame Magic spell utilizing mana words that he spent six months perfecting. Despite Dante’s terrifying Body Magic, Magna refuses to back down. Fueled by the grit that Ringmaster Yami always believed in, Magna prepares to go toe-to-toe with the devil himself!

 “Black Clover” 2nd Season – Series Information
 Season 2 officially premiered on Saturday, October 3, 2026, with new episodes dropping every Saturday on major streaming services. 
 ©YUKI TABATA/SHUEISHA,TV TOKYO,BLACK CLOVER PROJECT 
 Synopsis 
Within the fifth leaf of a clover resides a devil…
 In a world where magic is everything, Asta is the sole person born without any magical power. What he managed to obtain instead was “Anti-Magic”—a power capable of nullifying all magic.
 Now, the “Dark Triad,” rulers of the Spade Kingdom who harbor the powers of underworld devils, have begun their scorched-earth invasion of the world. As their conquest accelerates, Queen Lolopechka of the Heart Kingdom, and even Magic Knight Captains Yami and Vangeance of the Clover Kingdom, are snatched away.
 To take back everything they’ve lost, Asta must step into the realm of the forbidden and claim the “True Power of the Devil!”
